The difference is the "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan. Next I'll read its CSS.
The `z-index: -1` puts the ribbon behind the card's background. I'll remove it.

content.text:
The pricing page is fixed. The "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan was hidden behind the card because `.plan-ribbon` in `site/css/pages.css` had `z-index: -1`. I removed that line.

The visual and functional tests now all pass (28 passed), including the pricing screenshots at desktop and phone size. I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
